how voices work

read in someone’s voice, with their permission. when a session says that, here is exactly what it means.

the people who read on infinite hill license their voice to us. we build a voice model from recordings they approve — sometimes a studio session, sometimes recordings that already exist — and we use it for one thing: reading sessions that we wrote, a keeper read, and they approved. every one. before it plays.

the voice never improvises. it is never connected to anything that makes up sentences. it does not answer your questions. it does not send you notifications. it reads what is on the page and nothing else.

the guide is not a voice. when you ask the guide something, you get text, from this door’s texts by default — and from any tradition’s own texts if you ask about it — with the source shown. if the guide ever speaks, it is the house voice, and it says so.

keepers and scholars are never synthesized. not for the app, not for a demo, not ever.

every voice can walk away. if a reader ends their license, their sessions are re-read in the house voice and their model is deleted within thirty days, in writing.

see also: biometric consent, keeper & provenance.

start now. it's free.
